subject: youtube.channel.file_404
summary: «ملف 404» is a digital mystery/internet investigation channel built around checkable evidence, confidence-labelled conclusions and cyber-safety boundaries rather than conspiracy or harmful instructions.

details.audience: Arabic 16–34 interested in mystery, technology, short stories and non-violent digital crime
details.narrative: weirdest evidence cold open -> one question -> timeline -> narrow hypotheses -> simplified technical explanation -> verdict with confidence
details.visual_direction: digital dossier; dark blue + teal/coral; limited CRT/glitch; node maps; timestamps; designed system windows rather than stolen screenshots
guardrails: explain what happened, not how to execute an attack
pilot: Short: the account that posts every day at the exact same second
7 min: how is a digital store identity stolen?
Short: three signs that reveal fake evidence
